name: ai-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins and mods by smhnkmr: model routing and other harness tooling.

plugins.name: local-router
plugins.description: Routes each Claude Code subagent to a model by task complexity, locally. Heavy work to Opus, light checks to Sonnet, read-only research to Haiku.

plugins.name: orchestrator
plugins.description: Makes the main model an orchestrator: four named cheap agents to delegate to, and the facts it needs to decide what to delegate. A switch, no prompting required.
